# Model file format (generated)

Current schema version: **29** (`nagasim/core/schema/migrate.py`). See [Model file format](../model-file-format.md) for the full field-by-field guide; this page is the generated top-level key list. `naga schema` prints the whole JSON Schema; a file saved by an older version is migrated forward when it is read.

## Top-level keys

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `blocks` | Every block in the model: `name`, `type`, `position` (centre, scene units), `params`. |
| `resources` | Named resources: capacity, queue discipline, optional ranking expression, capacity schedule, cost fields. |
| `links` | Ordered list of `{source, target, delay?, source_port?, target_port?}`; array order is branch order, and several links may join the same pair of blocks (a link is identified by source, target and which of the parallel links it is). |
| `scenarios` | Named parameter-override sets, run and compared by `nagasim.experiments`. |
| `orders` | Released jobs with a due date, emitted by a CREATE block in "Orders" arrival mode. |
| `resource_sets` | Named groups of resources with a selection rule, seized as one pseudo-resource. |
| `schedules` | Piecewise-constant arrival-rate or capacity schedules, optionally repeating. |
| `failures` | Resource failures: uptime/downtime distribution pairs per named resource group. |
| `tables` | Named 1-D/2-D lookup tables read by TABLE("name", k1[, k2]) in any expression. |
| `sequences` | Named routings: ordered steps through STATION blocks, walked by a ROUTE block. |
| `variables` | Model-level variables, read and written by expressions; reset to `initial` each replication. |
| `entities` | Entity types: shape, colour, optional WIP holding cost. |
| `timeseries_inputs` | Named time-series profiles read by TS("name") in any expression. |
| `levels` | Continuous quantities with bounds (battery energy, tank volume, an inventory position), read by LEVEL("name"). |
| `flows` | Rate-based transfers between levels, re-evaluated at events. |
| `conversions` | Delayed conversions with a yield curve: feed in, product released over the following hours or days. |
| `fixed_costs` | Costs of the scenario rather than of the run: capex (flagged `capex: true` for the investment case), or an annuity over a sized parameter. |
| `fleets` | Pools of vehicles that carry entities on the network; a fleet is a resource under its own name. |
| `motion_profiles` | How robots, people and mechanisms move: speed, acceleration, payload derating and a collaborative speed, named by a MOTION block's `profile`. |
| `zones` | Safety zones: a network node and a radius that a MOTION block's or a tending group's `zone.name` binds to; a worker inside slows the robot to its collaborative speed. |
| `chargers` | Chargers and battery-swap stations at network nodes, used by fleets that declare a `battery`. |
| `auxiliaries` | Named expressions read by AUX("name"), evaluated on read. |
| `delays` | Delays read by DELAY("name"): input, delay time, kind and order. |
| `subscripts` | Dimensions: a record with "dims" is flattened into one record per element. |
| `agent_types` | Statecharts run for every agent of a population: parameters, states, transitions. |
| `populations` | Agent populations: a type, a count and an initial placement. |
| `reality_checks` | Vensim-style reality checks: a test input and a constraint the model must then satisfy. |
| `network` | Optional path network: nodes at layout coordinates and the segments joining them. |
| `annotations` | Text notes and frames drawn behind blocks on the canvas; ignored by the engine. |
| `submodels` | Reusable definitions (parameters, inner blocks/links/ports), flattened before a run. |
| `background` | Optional floor-plan image: path, position, scale, opacity, lock, real-world scale. |
| `info` | Optional model metadata: description, author, notes; shown in the report header. |
| `data_sources` | Declared CSV/Excel/SQLite/SQL/JSON sources model parameters can be read from. |
| `data_bindings` | Which column, filtered and transformed how, feeds which override path. |
| `initial_state` | Warm start: entities already in blocks, variable values and resource states the run begins with. |
| `simulation` | Run settings: time_limit, warmup, replications, time_unit, currency, entity_log_limit, and the optional real-date calendar. |
| `assertions` | Model assertions: a KPI, a comparison operator/value and a replication/confidence budget, checked by `naga check`. |

## Units

Every quantity field names its unit in a sibling key; a missing unit or "base" means the model's own (`simulation.time_unit`, `simulation.length_unit`).

| Quantity | Units |
|---|---|
| time | milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years |
| length | millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers |
| speed | m/s, m/min, km/h (any `<length>/<time>`, e.g. `mm/s`) |
| mass | g, kg, t |
| energy | Wh, kWh, MWh |
| power | W, kW, MW |
| rate | milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years |

## Plant mapping format (`*.plantmap.json`)

Format **1**, from `nagasim/plant.py`. Start one with `naga plant init`, judge one with `naga plant check`. See [A plant as a timeline](../plant-timeline.md) for the guide.

The `time` section:

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `epoch` | ISO 8601 instant that model time 0 stands for; with no offset it is UTC. |
| `unit` | The model's time unit (default: the model's own). |
| `stamp` | Which stamp of an observation is its time (default: the source's). |

A `signals` entry:

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `source` | Only observations of this data source. |
| `key` | The observation's key. An "at" or "order" key holds one {id}; a "job" key may hold one *. |
| `field` | The cell to read when the value is a row. |
| `as` | What the key asserts. |
| `resource` | A resource or a fleet of the model. |
| `block` | A block of the flattened model ("step": a MOTION block, whose value is the segment its job runs, from 0; null when idle). |
| `level` | A level of the model. |
| `fleet` | "vehicle", "load", "tend": a fleet of the model. |
| `unit` | "vehicle", "load", "tend": which vehicle of the fleet, from 0 (default 0). |
| `cycles` | "tend": plant value -> pick, place, idle. |
| `nodes` | "vehicle": plant value -> the network node the vehicle is at. |
| `states` | Plant value -> busy, idle, blocked, down, up. |
| `blocks` | Plant value -> block. |
| `gone` | Values that end the entity (a null always does). |
| `merged` | Values that take it into a batch. |
| `type` | The entity type of what this signal names. |
| `type_field` | The cell of a row that holds the product. |
| `attributes` | "at": cell of a row -> the entity attribute its number sets. |
| `batch_field` | "at": the cell of a merged member's row that holds the id of its batch. |
| `types` | Product -> entity type. |
| `order_field` | "at": the cell of a row that holds the id of the item's order. |
| `fields` | "order": type, quantity, done, due, priority, release, status -> the cell of the order's row that holds it (status always). |
| `sequences` | "order": product -> a sequence of the model. |
| `statuses` | "order": plant status -> waiting, held, released, done, gone. |
| `leaves` | "seen": the entity has left. |
| `scale` | "level": model value = value * scale. |
| `rollover` | "counter": the value the plant's counter returns to 0 at. |
